caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornately constructed wooden table with a dark brown color. The tabletop is rectangular with chamfered corners and distinct wood grain texture visible throughout. The base consists of a thick, central pedestal with geometric, angular carvings, and a large, round knob projecting from one side. The pedestal attaches to a broad base plate that mimics the tabletop’s beveled-edge shape and extends outward for stability, supported by smaller feet with visible small wheels or casters at the corners. The entire composition is framed by a thin rectangular border and is set against a plain, light beige background. The name "MAGNUS S. FOSSUM." is faintly visible in the lower left of the border.
title: Invalid Bedside Table
